workflow_rule.name: Generate Invoice on Closed Won
workflow_rule.description: Triggers invoice creation in Zoho Books when a deal reaches Closed Won stage

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: The ID of the deal that triggered the workflow

prerequisites: Zoho Finance Suite must be connected and active
Zoho Books Organization ID must be set in the function
Deals must have a linked Contact with a valid Email
Zoho Books must have matching products for line items

steps: Create test Deal linked to Contact
Verify invoice appears in Zoho Books

common_errors.fix: Remove connection parameter or use available connection name

common_errors.error: The request could not be authenticated

common_errors.fix: Add Email to the linked Contact
Verify Books Organization ID and Contact details
